skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and measure the probability of random events through probability measures, formulas, and applications in economics and finance, in decision-making theory.
Understand random variables and probability distributions, their characteristics, and common distributions in economics and finance.
Describe random phenomena, calculate probabilities and characteristics with specific economic and financial situations; use software and R language to support calculations and random simulations.
Be proactive in learning, researching, and solving practical problems.
Apply mathematical concepts to measure and analyze random phenomena.
Use probability theory to support decision-making processes.
Use Microsoft Excel and R for practical calculations and simulations.
Analyze situations, classify events, and apply appropriate probability formulas.
Participate in discussions, present solutions, and engage in collaborative learning.
